defect_location.description: CVE-2018-10933: libssh 服务端状态机缺陷（CVE 描述: A malicious client could create channels without first performing authentication, resulting in unauthorized access）。状态机逻辑错误 → 诚实标 miss。

source.simplification: 剥离 libssh 分组加密/传输层，以等价服务端状态机镜像『未认证即可处理 CHANNEL_OPEN』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: 认证完成前客户端发送 SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_OPEN(90) → 通道被创建
